raw_response: BNY Mellon described its ETF servicing business as showing "particular strength" that validated multiyear investments. Specifically, for the period discussed (which includes data from late 2024), ETF Assets Under Custody and Administration (AUCA) reached $2.8 trillion, representing an increase of over 60% year-over-year. Additionally, inflows into ETFs on BNY's platform outpaced the market.
